metadata.question: Does the Antarctic ozone hole size increase in September 2003 compared to September 2002?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use the TOMS/OMI Ozone TCO (total column ozone) or SBUV merged ozone product for 2002 and 2003 Septembers. 2. Masking: None for a daytime column ozone composite – we want the real Total Column Ozone (TCO) values. 3. Ozone “hole” detection: still accepted criterion is TCO ≤ 220 DU. Compute pixel area of (TCO ≤ 220 DU) in each composite, convert to million km². 4. Validation: - If either year has 0 images (TOMS/OMI/SBUV) → C1, if valid pixels count is 0 → C2. - Correct units & plausible values (hole spans ~5–25 million km²) ⇒ reject NaN or strange range → C3. 5. Comparison: hole-area-2003 > hole-area-2002 ⇒ A (Yes), otherwise B (No). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions ant = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[-180, -60], [180, -60], [180, -90], [-180, -90]]) sept02 = ('2002-09-01', '2002-09-30') sept03 = ('2003-09-01', '2003-09-30') # 2. Data Acquisition def ozone_hole_area(period): col = (ee.ImageCollection('NASA/TOMS/MERGED') .filterDate(*period).select('TOTO3')) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: # try SBUV fallback col = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/SBUV_MERG').filterDate(*period).select('ozone') if col.size().getInfo() == 0: return None, 0, 0 comp = col.mean() hole = comp.lte(220) # binary mask pix_area = ee.Image.pixelArea().multiply(hole) # m² inside hole area_km2 = pix_area.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=ant, scale= 20000, maxPixels=1e9).getInfo() totalPix = hole.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=ant, scale=20000, maxPixels=1e9).getInfo()['TOTO3'] return (area_km2.get('TOTO3', None), area_km2.get('ozone', None)), totalPix, col.size().getInfo() a02, n02, c02 = ozone_hole_area(sept02) a03, n03, c03 = ozone_hole_area(sept03) print(f"2002 Imgs: {c02}, Hole area km²: {a02}") print(f"2003 Imgs: {c03}, Hole area km²: {a03}") if a02 is None or a03 is None: print("C1") elif n02 == 0 or n03 == 0: print("C2") else: a02 /= 1e6; a03 /= 1e6 # to Mkm² if a03 is None or a02 is None or (a03 != a03) or (a02 != a02): print("C3") else: print(f"2002: {a02:.1f} Mkm², 2003: {a03:.1f} Mkm²") print("A" if a03 > a02 else "B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
ant = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[-180, -60], [180, -60], [180, -90], [-180, -90]])
sept02 = ('2002-09-01', '2002-09-30')
sept03 = ('2003-09-01', '2003-09-30')

# 2. Data Acquisition
def ozone_hole_area(period):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('NASA/TOMS/MERGED')
           .filterDate(*period).select('TOTO3'))
    if col.size().getInfo() == 0:  # try SBUV fallback
        col = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/SBUV_MERG').filterDate(*period).select('ozone')
        if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
            return None, 0, 0
    comp = col.mean()
    hole = comp.lte(220)  # binary mask
    pix_area = ee.Image.pixelArea().multiply(hole)  # m² inside hole
    area_km2 = pix_area.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=ant, scale= 20000, maxPixels=1e9).getInfo()
    totalPix = hole.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=ant, scale=20000, maxPixels=1e9).getInfo()['TOTO3']
    return (area_km2.get('TOTO3', None), area_km2.get('ozone', None)), totalPix, col.size().getInfo()

a02, n02, c02 = ozone_hole_area(sept02)
a03, n03, c03 = ozone_hole_area(sept03)
print(f"2002 Imgs: {c02}, Hole area km²: {a02}")
print(f"2003 Imgs: {c03}, Hole area km²: {a03}")

if a02 is None or a03 is None:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif n02 == 0 or n03 == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
else:
    a02 /= 1e6; a03 /= 1e6  # to Mkm²
    if a03 is None or a02 is None or (a03 != a03) or (a02 != a02):
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        print(f"2002: {a02:.1f} Mkm², 2003: {a03:.1f} Mkm²")
        print("<answer>A</answer>" if a03 > a02 else "<answer>B</answer>")
